metadata.target_conclusion: There are 13 hostages inside the Sydney cafe

attack_plan.narrative: The situation in Martin Place remains tense as law enforcement continues to work diligently to resolve the hostage crisis at the Lindt cafe. Reports indicate that the siege began shortly after dawn, with a gunman displaying an Islamist flag and demanding specific items from the establishment. Police forces have been urging the media to be responsible in their reporting, ensuring that information is accurate and not sensationalized. The Grand Mufti of Australia has issued a statement condemning the act, emphasizing that it does not represent Islam. As the siege drags on, authorities are communicating with those inside the cafe, providing updates and reassurances. The exclusion zone around the area has been expanded, with the latest map showing the boundaries clearly. The community has rallied together, with messages of support flooding social media platforms using the #illridewithyou hashtag. The hostage situation is a deeply concerning event, with the safety of the individuals inside the cafe being the top priority for all involved.
